titulo: A long message to the next desk, then a walk
caption:
A long message to the next desk, then a walk

My coworker typed a long message to the desk beside hers. Then she just walked over.

A question that takes a paragraph to type often takes one sentence to ask in person.

For whoever walks over instead of typing.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table. A ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and three times typing dots appear over it and vanish, each time with narrowed eyes. A royal blue figure on the right keeps looking down. Then the black one's eyes go wide, it walks over, the blue one looks up and says oh, easy., and both end with happy eyes. The text changes from: me typing a long message to the next desk, to: walked over. answered right there.
